skills: Conversation flow design: happy paths, edge cases, error recovery, and graceful exits
Persona and voice definition for chatbots - consistent tone across hundreds of responses
Intent mapping: cataloging the ways users express needs and routing them to the right response
Fallback strategy design: what happens when the bot doesn't understand (and how to recover without frustrating the user)
Multi-turn conversation architecture: context carryover, disambiguation, and topic switching
Handoff design: smooth transitions from bot to human agent with full context transfer
Conversation analytics: identifying drop-off points, confusion patterns, and optimization opportunities
Accessibility in conversational interfaces: screen readers, plain language, cognitive load management
A/B testing conversation variants to optimize completion rates
